annotations.title: Deep Research Dossier & Citation Intelligence Brief

description: Compiles multi-source factual research briefs with verified citations, confidence intervals, and key analytical takeaways. Use when synthesizing comprehensive intelligence briefings on complex technical, scientific, or market developments; for rapid query search snippets, use synthesize_neural_search instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'research_topic' ('depth_level' defaults to 'executive_brief'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (35 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

depth_level.description: Research dossier rigor: executive brief, deep investigation, or technical whitepaper.

research_topic.description: Complex subject, market sector, emerging technology, or policy topic to research.

target_citations.description: Target number of primary citations to identify and verify.

name: compile_research_dossier

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for compile_research_dossier.

citations.description: Verified source citations backing the analytical findings.

confidence_index.description: Epistemic confidence index between 0.0 and 1.0 based on source consensus.

executive_summary.description: High-level analytical summary of primary findings and consensus.

key_findings.description: Structured list of core factual insights with supporting context.

title.description: Title of the compiled research dossier.

title: Deep Research Dossier & Citation Intelligence Brief
